cited.quote: Necessary training will be imparted to farmers to produce quality palm jaggery with latest technologies

rationale: C1 is a budget speech stating training and subsidy for modern jaggery machinery 'will be' provided: intent only. C3/C4 are a GO on selling palm jaggery through Fair Price Shops, not on production or processing technology. C5 is unrelated. No official step for technology upgrade.

cited.quote: distribution of fertilizers and pesticides, establishment of agri clinic, micro-irrigation service centers

rationale: C1 is a budget speech listing agri clinics only as one possible venture for agri-graduate entrepreneurs; it is a plan, not an official step to establish Agro Clinics. C2-C5 concern other subjects (museum, RKVY projects, crop insurance, diploma NOC).

cited.quote: Appointment of 2100 Medical Officers Temporarily - On Contract Basis - For a Period of 6 Months
Appointment of Para Personnel on contract basis in Government Medical Institutions under the Director of Medical Education

rationale: C5, C3 and C2 are temporary contract or outsourced engagements for COVID-19 exigencies, not filling of regular vacancies or regularisation of contract workers. C1 and C4 concern health insurance empanelment. No step for the commitment itself.
No extract concerns urging the Union government to declare Thirukkural a national text. C1/C2 cover textbook printing and translations; C3-C5 are unrelated GOs.
No extract concerns withdrawing cases against protesting employees. C1 is an inspection report on disciplinary cases in a cooperative office; C2, C4, C5 allocate RTI subjects; C3 is a lockdown order.
No extract concerns the release of the seven convicts. C1-C5 cover COVID orphan relief, bonded labour SOP and urban schemes.

cited.quote: a research centre in the name of Natural farming Scientist “Nammazhvar” will be created

rationale: C2 is a budget speech announcing the Nammazhvar research centre will be created with Rs.3 crore to be allocated: an announcement, not an operational step. No GO for the centre in C3-C5.

cited.quote: Library at Kotturpuram, Chennai, the second largest library in South Asia was built at an estimated cost of Rs.197.43 crore

rationale: C1 and C2 (policy note) describe the existing Anna Centenary Library and its ongoing services; no renovation or upgrade order. C3-C5 are unrelated schemes.

cited.quote: Hence, a separate Ministry for Water Resources has been established.

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) and C2 (GO creating a Water Resources Department) are related administrative changes, not a statutory Water Management Authority with climate and water experts for inter-State bargaining. No official step for the authority.

cited.quote: Adequate investments will also be made in the transmission and distribution networks to ensure uninterrupted supply of electricity.

rationale: C2 (revised budget speech) and C1 (Governor's address) state general intentions on uninterrupted power; nothing on new power lines for industries or industrial estates. C3-C5 are unrelated.
No extract concerns urging the Union for ESI hospitals in Tiruppur and Erode. C1 lists contract posts in hospitals; C2-C5 list insurance network hospitals.

cited.quote: The Milk produced by Cattle rearing farmers are procured by Milk Producers Co-operative Societies at a remunerative price.

rationale: C1 touches milk procurement by Aavin and C2 a retail price cut, but no extract shows a commission to regulate procurement and distribution prices. C3-C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: The energy and enthusiasm of the youth will be harnessed to restore and conserve water bodies across Tamil Nadu.

rationale: Directional. C1 (Governor's address) states intent and mentions channel desilting, but no extract is a GO ordering maintenance of water bodies. C2-C5 are unrelated GOs.

cited.quote: may be taken up under Namakku Naame Thittam:- i. Renovation of water bodies.

rationale: Directional. C5 lists renovation of water bodies only as one eligible work in a broad urban public-contribution scheme, not a dedicated sanction. C1/C3 are Finance Commission grants for drinking water and sanitation; C2 roads; C4 a statement of intent.

cited.quote: two nodes Madurai–Dindigul- Virudhunagar-Theni and Thoothukudi-Tirunelveli have been prioritized for Phase-I development

rationale: C1 (policy note) reports nodes of the broader Chennai-Kanniyakumari corridor, not a dedicated Madurai-Thoothukudi industrial corridor. C3 announces parks; C4/C5 are Madurai Ring Road GOs. No official step for the promised corridor.
No extract concerns tree planting along the promised route. C1 mentions palm planting on tank bunds and road sides generally; C2 is MGNREGS rates; C3-C5 are unrelated.
No extract concerns bringing ration shops under a single department. C1-C5 are COVID lockdown orders merely permitting PDS shops to operate.
No extract concerns the Palar-Thamirabarani riverbed project. C1/C2 cover general river, wetland and urban schemes; C3/C4 land records; C5 agriculture targets.

cited.quote: Suitable subjects under Under Graduate Agricultural courses will be included as electives

rationale: C1 is a budget speech plan for entrepreneurship electives for agricultural students, not an official step introducing farming technologies to students. C3 is teacher ICT training; C4/C5 are farmer demonstrations.
No extract concerns powerloom electricity tariffs. C1 covers TIIC loan schemes; C2 MSME subsidy relaxation; C3/C5 solar pumps; C4 minimum wages.
